argv:
import json, copy, subprocess, sys
sys.path.insert(0, "scripts")
import ledger as L
text = open("docs/missions/ledger.jsonl", encoding="utf-8").read()
assert "self_reported_model" not in text
rows = [json.loads(line) for line in text.splitlines() if line.strip()]
assert len(rows) == 29
for row in rows:
    assert row["schema_version"] == 2 and "self_reported_model" not in row
    L.validate_row(row)
    assert "self_reported_model" not in row
good = copy.deepcopy(rows[0])
good["self_reported_model"] = {"value": "reported-model", "source": "self_reported"}
L.validate_row(good)
bad = copy.deepcopy(rows[0])
bad["self_reported_model"] = {"value": "m", "source": "observed"}
try:
    L.validate_row(bad)
except L.LedgerError as error:
    assert str(error) == "self_reported_model.source: must be one of self_reported, unknown", str(error)
else:
    raise SystemExit("bad source accepted")
schema = json.loads(open("schemas/ledger-row.schema.json", encoding="utf-8").read())
assert schema["properties"]["schema_version"] == {"const": 2}
assert "self_reported_model" not in schema["required"]
assert schema["properties"]["self_reported_model"]["$ref"] == "#/$defs/selfReportedTextFlag"
assert schema["$defs"]["selfReportedTextFlag"]["properties"]["source"]["enum"] == ["self_reported", "unknown"]
view = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "scripts/ledger.py", "view", "docs/missions/ledger.jsonl", "--features", "docs/missions/20261014-2a-foundation/features.json"], capture_output=True, text=True)
assert view.returncode == 0, view.stderr
assert view.stderr == ""
assert view.stdout.startswith("first_try_rate "), view.stdout
print("ok")
